# A whole iOS-like round: discovery, the home set Depth 1 (ctag, token),
# a change elsewhere moves the ctag, sync-collection names it,
# calendar-multiget fetches it, the iPhone adds an event (If-None-Match:
# *), and the next sync names only its own change, with the ETag the PUT
# gave and a new token.
@seed calendar privat 2F0E6A64-1B7C-4E5A-9C1D-6A8E0B3D4C21.ics weekly-team.ics

> PROPFIND /.well-known/caldav
> Auth: none
> Depth: 0
< status 301
< header Location /caldav/

> PROPFIND /caldav/
> Auth: alex
> Depth: 0
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <A:propfind xmlns:A="DAV:"><A:prop><A:current-user-principal/></A:prop></A:propfind>
< status 207
< value /caldav/ d:current-user-principal /caldav/alex/

> PROPFIND /caldav/alex/
> Auth: alex
> Depth: 0
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <A:propfind xmlns:A="DAV:" xmlns:C="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav"><A:prop><C:calendar-home-set/><A:principal-URL/><A:displayname/><A:supported-report-set/></A:prop></A:propfind>
< status 207
< value /caldav/alex/ cal:calendar-home-set /caldav/alex/calendars/

> PROPFIND /caldav/alex/calendars/
> Auth: alex
> Depth: 1
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <A:propfind xmlns:A="DAV:" xmlns:B="http://calendarserver.org/ns/" xmlns:C="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav" xmlns:D="http://apple.com/ns/ical/"><A:prop><B:getctag/><A:sync-token/><A:resourcetype/><A:displayname/><D:calendar-color/><D:calendar-order/><C:supported-calendar-component-set/><A:current-user-privilege-set/><A:supported-report-set/></A:prop></A:propfind>
< status 207
< responses 3
# (and the virtual reminder list, 1.13: reminders.txt)
< value /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/ d:supported-report-set <d:sync-collection/>
< save ctag prop /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/ cs:getctag
< save token prop /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/ d:sync-token

# Initial sync and fetch.
> REPORT /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/
> Auth: alex
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <A:sync-collection xmlns:A="DAV:"><A:sync-token/><A:sync-level>1</A:sync-level><A:prop><A:getetag/><A:getcontenttype/></A:prop></A:sync-collection>
< status 207
< responses 1
< sync-token-is {saved:token}

# Elsewhere (the web UI) a new event.
@seed calendar privat 6D3B0C8E-5F21-4A77-B0C4-1E9D2A7F3B55.ics dentist.ics

> PROPFIND /caldav/alex/calendars/
> Auth: alex
> Depth: 1
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <A:propfind xmlns:A="DAV:" xmlns:B="http://calendarserver.org/ns/"><A:prop><B:getctag/><A:sync-token/></A:prop></A:propfind>
< status 207
< value-not /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/ cs:getctag {saved:ctag}

> REPORT /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/
> Auth: alex
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <A:sync-collection xmlns:A="DAV:"><A:sync-token>{saved:token}</A:sync-token><A:sync-level>1</A:sync-level><A:prop><A:getetag/><A:getcontenttype/></A:prop></A:sync-collection>
< status 207
< responses 1
< value /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/6D3B0C8E-5F21-4A77-B0C4-1E9D2A7F3B55.ics d:getetag {etag:dentist.ics}
< save token sync-token

> REPORT /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/
> Auth: alex
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <C:calendar-multiget xmlns:A="DAV:" xmlns:C="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav"><A:prop><A:getetag/><C:calendar-data/></A:prop><A:href>/caldav/alex/calendars/privat/6D3B0C8E-5F21-4A77-B0C4-1E9D2A7F3B55.ics</A:href></C:calendar-multiget>
< status 207
< data /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/6D3B0C8E-5F21-4A77-B0C4-1E9D2A7F3B55.ics dentist.ics

# The iPhone adds an event.
> PUT /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/4E2A9C11-7B3D-4F60-A1E2-3C4D5E6F7081.ics
> Auth: alex
> Content-Type: text/calendar; charset=utf-8
> If-None-Match: *
> Body: running.ics
< status 201
< save etag header ETag

> REPORT /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/
> Auth: alex
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <A:sync-collection xmlns:A="DAV:"><A:sync-token>{saved:token}</A:sync-token><A:sync-level>1</A:sync-level><A:prop><A:getetag/></A:prop></A:sync-collection>
< status 207
< responses 1
< value /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/4E2A9C11-7B3D-4F60-A1E2-3C4D5E6F7081.ics d:getetag {saved:etag}
< sync-token-not {saved:token}
< save token sync-token

# Quiet again: the same ctag, an empty sync, no disk.
